managementNamespace.description: The management-plane namespace the umbrella created (zone fact planes.management.namespace).

enabled.description: Open the bootstrap Job's API lane with a CiliumNetworkPolicy (zone fact cni.cilium.enabled).

mode.description: The zone's mesh mode (zone fact mesh.mode); with any mode but none the release renders the allow rules of its own pairs.

trustDomain.description: The zone's SPIFFE trust domain (zone fact zone.trustDomain); required when mesh.mode is not none.

openbao.description: Values of the upstream openbao chart.

enabled.description: The bundled server; false to verify an external OpenBao.

image.description: The bootstrap Job's and the verification hook's image, pinned by digest.

address.description: Address of an OpenBao the zone does not own, https only (the verification token crosses the network to it); exclusive with openbao.server.enabled.

verifyTokenSecret.description: Secret in the management namespace holding the verification token (key verify-token).

then.$comment: Both modes at once are refused. The required name is the message Helm prints: either the release installs OpenBao or it verifies an existing one.
